newsitem.title: USA: ADR REPORT - BioChem Pharma up in N.Y.
newsitem.headline: ADR REPORT - BioChem Pharma up in N.Y.

text.p: Canada's BioChem Pharma Inc rose Wednesday amid encouraging comments to highlight trade in foreign shares and American Depositary Receipts (ADRs).
Traders said the overall ADR market was fairly quiet as Wall Street eased, weighed by stronger-than-forecast March industrial output and capacity utilization data.
BioChem Pharma rose 1/4 to 19 and the stock was among foreign stocks' most active. Volume was 1.4 million shares traded by late morning.

The company had fallen Tuesday as markets reacted coolly to trial results on its hepatitis B drug lamivudine. The drug is licensed to Britain's Glaxo Wellcome Plc and Glaxo ADRs were unchanged at 36-1/8.
Robertson, Stephens & Co reiterated its buy rating on BioChem Pharma, saying the company was "on the cusp of experiencing strong earnings growth driven by" lamivudine and its AIDS drug 3TC.
Lehman Brothers also said pressure on the stock created a "buying opportunity," adding, "We would be aggressive buyers of the stock."
International news and information company Reuters Holdings Plc fell 7/16 to 57-1/16 after executives warned of the effect of strong sterling on its profits.
British biotechnology group Cortecs International Ltd rose 2-7/8 to 22-3/8 after a Nomura International analyst repeated his buy rating on the stock.
Among Latin American ADRs, Telefonos de Mexico rose one to 42-1/8.
Decliners led advancers 217 to 174 among 806 ADRs. The ADR index was down 0.02 percent and volume in late morning was 20 million shares.
